# Student Assistant with an Interest in ICT Risk, Information Security and Governance

Company:
Tryg Forsikring A/S

Location:
Ballerup

Are you interested in ICT risk, information security and governance in a large financial IT organisation? Would you like to gain hands-on experience with risk management processes, compliance and stakeholder coordination while studying? Then you might be the student assistant we are looking for in BID Governance, Risk and Control.

## About the Job | ICT Risk Management and Governance in Practice

As a Student Assistant in BID's Governance, Risk and Control team, you will support the Business Risk Officer in coordinating and improving ICT and information-security risk management across Tryg's IT organisation. You will gain practical experience throughout the entire risk lifecycle and help ensure that risk activities, documentation and follow-up are completed consistently and on time.

You will work with:

* Supporting the end-to-end ICT and information-security risk process, from identification and assessment to mitigation, monitoring and reporting.
* Coordinating input, actions and deadlines with risk owners and stakeholders across IT and the business.
* Maintaining risk registers, assessments, action plans and reporting data in Jira, Confluence and OneTrust.
* Preparing risk overviews and materials for governance forums, monitoring activities and management reporting.
* Supporting process improvements and contributing to ad hoc information-security, governance, compliance and risk-related tasks.

Beyond your day-to-day responsibilities, you will gain insight into how a financial-services IT organisation manages risk, regulatory requirements and governance. You will be given responsibility for your own tasks while working closely with experienced colleagues who will support your professional development and learning.

We expect the position to be approximately 15 hours per week, distributed across two to three working days. We offer flexibility around classes, assignments and exam periods.

## About You | Structured, Analytical and Eager to Learn

You are currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree and have an interest in ICT risk, information security, governance, compliance or related areas. Your educational background is less important than your ability to work in a structured manner, think analytically and take ownership of your tasks.

We imagine that you:

* Work independently and take initiative.
* Stay organised, maintain an overview and follow through on tasks.
* Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively across teams and coordinate input and follow-up.
* Learn new tools and processes quickly and approach challenges analytically.

Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence or OneTrust is an advantage but not a requirement. The most important thing is that you are motivated to learn, comfortable taking responsibility and eager to develop your skills within ICT risk management and governance.

## About Us | Governance, Risk and Control at BID

BID is Tryg's IT organisation and plays a critical role in delivering reliable, secure and compliant technology services across the business. As a financial-services organisation, we operate in a highly regulated environment where ICT risk management, information security and governance are essential to maintaining resilient operations and supporting sound decision-making.

As part of the Governance, Risk and Control team, you will work closely with the Business Risk Officer and collaborate with colleagues across IT, risk management, business functions and control functions. You will gain valuable insight into both the operational and strategic aspects of risk management and governance within a large Nordic organisation.

You will join a collaborative and supportive team where knowledge sharing, professional development and personal responsibility are highly valued. We offer an environment where student assistants can build meaningful experience and develop competencies that are highly relevant for future careers within risk management, governance, compliance and information security.

## We Look Forward to Hearing from You!

Please send your application and CV no later than 13 December 2026. We encourage applicants not to include a photo in their CV.

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the position once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Malene Huse Eikrem, Business Risk Officer, on +45 42 77 61 68, or Cecilia Johansson, Head of BID GRC, on [cecilia.johansson@trygghansa.se](mailto:cecilia.johansson@trygghansa.se)
